s0101.literal: Reading the nominations you have submitted fills one with shame.
s0101.idiomatic: Reading the nominations you have submitted fills one with shame.

s0103.literal: " Because many Han people had gone south to Jiangnan for food, and many officials who had served in the south did not return when their terms ended, envoys were dispatched to move them all back north.
s0103.idiomatic: " Because many Han people had gone south to Jiangnan for food, and many officials who had served in the south did not return when their terms ended, envoys were sent to move them all back north.

s0104.literal: Tuotuohosun was also posted at ferry crossings on the Yellow River, Yangtze, and Huai, to stop any Han person going south without carrying official documents; merchants were permitted.
s0104.idiomatic: Tuotuohosun was also posted at ferry crossings on the Yellow River, Yangtze, and Huai to stop Han people going south without official documents; merchants were permitted.

s0105.literal: Central Secretariat officials said: "Recently, by imperial order, no thief was to be released.
s0105.idiomatic: Central Secretariat officials said, "Recently, by imperial order, no thief was to be released.

s0106.literal: Now those who steal a few strings of paper currency or petty objects such as wearing a knife on the belt, and children who steal objects, are all sentenced to penal service.
s0106.idiomatic: Now those who steal a few strings of paper currency or petty objects such as wearing a knife on the belt, and children who steal objects, are all sentenced to penal service.

s0107.literal: We deliberated that for a first offense flogging and release would be appropriate, and for a second offense penal service according to law.
s0107.idiomatic: We deliberated that for a first offense flogging and release would be appropriate, and for a second offense penal service according to law.

s0108.literal: " The Emperor said: "Because Han people show partiality and use the Taihe Code in handling cases, bandits and thieves have multiplied; hence my statement.
s0108.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "Because Han people show partiality and use the Taihe Code in handling cases, bandits and thieves have multiplied; hence my statement.

s0109.literal: Human life is of utmost weight; from now on, unless the case has been thoroughly tried, do not lightly put people to death."
s0109.idiomatic: Human life is of utmost weight; from now on, unless the case has been thoroughly tried, do not lightly put people to death."

s0110.literal: In the fifth month, on the dingmao new moon, Privy Council officials said: "We together with Yusutemur deliberated on military affairs at Bie Shibali; all troops on campaign should be under Bayan's command, while remaining duties should be entrusted to Bolundai and Prince Ajiji's staff to oversee, which is appropriate.
s0110.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the dingmao new moon, privy council officials said, "We together with Yusutemur deliberated on military affairs at Bie Shibali; all troops on campaign should be under Bayan's command, while remaining duties should be entrusted to Bolundai and Prince Ajiji's staff to oversee, which is appropriate.

s0112.literal: On jisi day Mars transgressed the Western Rampart Major General of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
s0112.idiomatic: On jisi day Mars transgressed the Western Rampart Major General of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

s0113.literal: Jinghu Branch Secretariat Ali Haiya memorialized: "When Yeshi Mu audited accounts in E Province, was there no bribery?
s0113.idiomatic: Jinghu branch secretariat Ali Haiya memorialized, "When Yeshi Mu audited accounts in E Province, was there no bribery?

s0114.literal: I also ask that my accounts be audited.
s0114.idiomatic: I also ask that my accounts be audited.

s0115.literal: " An edict dispatched associate administrator Tuluhan, privy council assessor Li Dao, and investigating censor Chen Tianxiang to go together.
s0115.idiomatic: " An edict dispatched associate administrator Tuluhan, privy council assessor Li Dao, and investigating censor Chen Tianxiang to go together.

s0116.literal: On jiaxu day Bianliang suffered drought.
s0116.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Bianliang suffered drought.

s0117.literal: The Jiangdong surveillance commission was moved to Xuanzhou.
s0117.idiomatic: The Jiangdong surveillance commission was moved to Xuanzhou.

s0118.literal: On gengchen day Jupiter transgressed Leibi Formation.
s0118.idiomatic: On gengchen day Jupiter transgressed Leibi Formation.

s0119.literal: On yiyou day Mars transgressed the Right Enforcer of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
s0119.idiomatic: On yiyou day Mars transgressed the Right Enforcer of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

s0120.literal: An edict dispatched four hundred Tamna garrison troops to return home.
s0120.idiomatic: An edict dispatched 400 Tamna garrison troops to return home.

s0121.literal: On gengyin day Guangping Circuit suffered silkworm calamity.
s0121.idiomatic: On gengyin day Guangping Circuit suffered silkworm calamity.

s0122.literal: On xinmao day Ba Prefecture and Huo Prefecture had locust nymphs.
s0122.idiomatic: On xinmao day Ba Prefecture and Huo Prefecture had locust nymphs.

s0123.literal: Annam sent envoys to present local products as tribute.
s0123.idiomatic: Annam sent envoys to present local products as tribute.

s0124.literal: On guisi day the capital region suffered drought.
s0124.idiomatic: On guisi day the capital region suffered drought.

s0125.literal: In the sixth month, on the bingshen new moon, Venus transgressed the Maid.
s0125.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the bingshen new moon, Venus transgressed the Maid.

s0126.literal: On xinchou day Central Secretariat officials said: "Tuluhan came to report that previously Yeshi Mu and Ali Haiya each requested that the other's accounts be audited; though Ali Haiya is now dead, right and wrong in the matter should be brought to light.
s0126.idiomatic: On xinchou day Central Secretariat officials said, "Tuluhan came to report that previously Yeshi Mu and Ali Haiya each requested that the other's accounts be audited; though Ali Haiya is now dead, right and wrong in the matter should be brought to light.

s0127.literal: " The Emperor said: "What you say is indeed correct; those connected by implication—those nearby should be pursued and arrested there, those far away should be reported upward.
s0127.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "What you say is indeed correct; those connected by implication—those nearby should be pursued and arrested there, those far away should be reported upward.

s0128.literal: This matter originated with Yeshi Mu; it should be thoroughly carried out according to his statement.
s0128.idiomatic: This matter originated with Yeshi Mu; it should be thoroughly carried out according to his statement.

s0129.literal: " On yisi day an edict proclaiming establishment of the Grand Secretariat for Agriculture was sent to inform court and realm.
s0129.idiomatic: " On yisi day an edict proclaiming establishment of the grand secretariat for agriculture was sent to inform court and realm.

s0130.literal: Imperial grandson Temur Buqa was garrisoned at Yixibuxi; his provisions depended on Xichuan, distant and inconvenient; he was moved to garrison Chongqing Prefecture.
s0130.idiomatic: Imperial grandson Temur Buqa was garrisoned at Yixibuxi; his provisions depended on Xichuan, distant and inconvenient, so he was moved to garrison Chongqing Prefecture.

s0131.literal: An edict ordered the book Essentials of Farming and Sericulture, compiled by the Grand Secretariat for Agriculture, to be issued to all circuits.
s0131.idiomatic: An edict ordered the book Essentials of Farming and Sericulture, compiled by the grand secretariat for agriculture, to be issued to all circuits.

s0132.literal: Yunnan and Shaanxi branch secretariats were ordered to register and fix capital-construction tax levies.
s0132.idiomatic: Yunnan and Shaanxi branch secretariats were ordered to register and fix capital-construction tax levies.

s0133.literal: On wushen day horses throughout all circuits were registered and requisitioned.
s0133.idiomatic: On wushen day horses throughout all circuits were registered and requisitioned.

s0134.literal: Among Semu people who had horses, two of every three were taken; all Han horses were confiscated to the state; those who dared conceal them or trade them privately were punished.
s0134.idiomatic: Among Semu people who had horses, two of every three were taken; all Han horses were confiscated to the state; those who dared conceal them or trade them privately were punished.

s0135.literal: On xinhai day Yimailan Tehuli was sent as envoy to Jiaozhi.
s0135.idiomatic: On xinhai day Yimailan Tehuli was sent as envoy to Jiaozhi.

s0136.literal: On guichou day Huguang Branch Secretariat Xian Ge said: "For the campaign against Jiaozhi we allocated twenty-eight thousand seven hundred garrison troops of this province, scheduled to assemble at Jingjiang in the seventh month; the elite force has already set out, but the remaining seventeen thousand eight hundred are debilitated, garrison-farm, and similar troops, unusable.
s0136.idiomatic: On guichou day Huguang branch secretariat Xian Ge said, "For the campaign against Jiaozhi we allocated 28,700 garrison troops of this province, scheduled to assemble at Jingjiang in the seventh month; the elite force has already set out, but the remaining 17,800 are debilitated, garrison-farm, and similar troops, unusable.

s0137.literal: " An edict suspended this for the present year.
s0137.idiomatic: " An edict suspended this for the present year.

s0138.literal: On dingsi day the Shaanxi and other circuits relay-station supervisorate was established, rank 3b.
s0138.idiomatic: On dingsi day the Shaanxi and other circuits relay-station supervisorate was established, rank 3b.

s0139.literal: On gengshen day one hundred eighteen newly enrolled impoverished households in Gansu were ordered to receive grain rations.
s0139.idiomatic: On gengshen day 118 newly enrolled impoverished households in Gansu were ordered to receive grain rations.

s0140.literal: An edict ordered bandit-catchers in circuits, prefectures, subprefectures, and counties to carry bows and arrows: circuits ten sets, prefectures and subprefectures seven sets, counties five sets.
s0140.idiomatic: An edict ordered bandit-catchers in circuits, prefectures, subprefectures, and counties to carry bows and arrows: circuits 10 sets, prefectures and subprefectures 7 sets, counties 5 sets.

s0141.literal: Xue Shegan was appointed Central Secretariat grand councillor.
s0141.idiomatic: Xue Shegan was appointed Central Secretariat grand councillor.

s0142.literal: On xinyou day Yang Bangxian's wife Lady Tian was enfeoffed as Lady of Yong'an Commandery and put in charge of Bozhou pacification commission affairs.
s0142.idiomatic: On xinyou day Yang Bangxian's wife Lady Tian was enfeoffed as Lady of Yong'an Commandery and put in charge of Bozhou pacification commission affairs.

s0143.literal: Western Yunnan Pingmian and other circuits pacification commissioner Qielie was dispatched to summon and instruct Burma.
s0143.idiomatic: Western Yunnan Pingmian and other circuits pacification commissioner Qielie was dispatched to summon and instruct Burma.

s0144.literal: In Langzhong, Guangyuan Circuit, wheat bore double ears.
s0144.idiomatic: In Langzhong, Guangyuan Circuit, wheat bore double ears.

s0145.literal: Goryeo sent envoys to present tribute.
s0145.idiomatic: Goryeo sent envoys to present tribute.

s0146.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the bingyin new moon, Pilaman and others were dispatched as envoys to Java.
s0146.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the bingyin new moon, Pilaman and others were dispatched as envoys to Java.

s0147.literal: On jisi day, acting on Central Secretariat officials' memorial, because much official land in Jiangnan had been seized by powerful families, a garrison-farm supervisorate was established, and the seized land was still measured acre by acre.
s0147.idiomatic: On jisi day, acting on Central Secretariat officials' memorial, because much official land in Jiangnan had been seized by powerful families, a garrison-farm supervisorate was established, and the seized land was still measured acre by acre.

s0148.literal: The imperial wine bureau was restored as the Court of Imperial Entertainments; the Liaoyang and other places branch secretariat was abolished; the Beijing, Xianping, and other three pacification commissions were restored.
s0148.idiomatic: The imperial wine bureau was restored as the Court of Imperial Entertainments; the Liaoyang and other places branch secretariat was abolished; the Beijing, Xianping, and other three pacification commissions were restored.

s0149.literal: The impoverished Tiegusi Hedu was granted two thousand bolts each of silk and cloth, and one thousand bolts of plain cloth.
s0149.idiomatic: The impoverished Tiegusi Hedu was granted 2,000 bolts each of silk and cloth, and 1,000 bolts of plain cloth.

s0150.literal: On gengwu day Jianghuai Branch Secretariat Mangwudai said: "The province is now at Hangzhou; revenue and military supplies from Lianghuai, Jiangdong, and other circuits are transported south and then back north again, which is inconvenient.
s0150.idiomatic: On gengwu day Jianghuai branch secretariat Mangwudai said, "The province is now at Hangzhou; revenue and military supplies from Lianghuai, Jiangdong, and other circuits are transported south and then back north again, which is inconvenient.

s0151.literal: Yangzhou commands the rivers and sea; the province should be established there, with a heavy garrison stationed; transport would then avoid round-trip labor; moving the branch secretariat to Yangzhou would be advantageous.
s0151.idiomatic: Yangzhou commands the rivers and sea; the province should be established there, with a heavy garrison stationed; transport would then avoid round-trip labor; moving the branch secretariat to Yangzhou would be advantageous.

s0153.literal: Garrison farms were established at Hongze and Shaopi in Huainan.
s0153.idiomatic: Garrison farms were established at Hongze and Shaopi in Huainan.

s0154.literal: On renshen day hungry people from Pingyang who had gone to neighboring prefectures for food were given relief from local granaries wherever they were.
s0154.idiomatic: On renshen day hungry people from Pingyang who had gone to neighboring prefectures for food were given relief from local granaries wherever they were.

s0155.literal: The Central Imperial Workshop Bureau was established.
s0155.idiomatic: The Central Imperial Workshop Bureau was established.

s0156.literal: Right vice censor Baidu'er led troops to suppress Ameng, captured him together with his wife and children, and all were executed.
s0156.idiomatic: Right vice censor Baidu'er led troops to suppress Ameng, captured him together with his wife and children, and all were executed.

s0157.literal: On dingchou day the people of Wotuogesi's tribe suffered famine; they were sent to find food in Beijing; those who did not go were given rice relief.
s0157.idiomatic: On dingchou day the people of Wotuogesi's tribe suffered famine; they were sent to find food in Beijing; those who did not go were given rice relief.

s0158.literal: Xiong and Yi prefectures were again placed under Baoding.
s0158.idiomatic: Xiong and Yi prefectures were again placed under Baoding.

s0159.literal: Army provisions for Karakorum were supplied: ten thousand shi of rice were shipped from the capital, and paper currency was issued to purchase ten thousand shi of rice locally.
s0159.idiomatic: Army provisions for Karakorum were supplied: 10,000 shi of rice were shipped from the capital, and paper currency was issued to purchase 10,000 shi of rice locally.

s0160.literal: On xinsi day six hundred famine-stricken households of Badu'er, stationed in Balghas, were given one thousand shi of rice in relief.
s0160.idiomatic: On xinsi day 600 famine-stricken households of Badu'er, stationed in Balghas, were given 1,000 shi of rice in relief.

s0161.literal: On renwu day general controllerate commissioner Sangge presented a list of provincial ministers; the Emperor said: "Right grand councillor Antong, right vice censor Maisuding, associate administrators Guo You and Yang Jukuan—all retain their former posts.
s0161.idiomatic: On renwu day general controllerate commissioner Sangge presented a list of provincial ministers; the Emperor said, "Right grand councillor Antong, right vice censor Maisuding, associate administrators Guo You and Yang Jukuan—all retain their former posts.

s0162.literal: Temur is made left vice censor; left grand councillor Wengjiladai, grand councillor Abishihe, and Duhulu will be considered separately.
s0162.idiomatic: Temur is made left vice censor; left grand councillor Wengjiladai, grand councillor Abishihe, and Duhulu will be considered separately.

s0163.literal: " The Central Secretariat was also instructed to select suitable replacements and report.
s0163.idiomatic: " The Central Secretariat was also instructed to select suitable replacements and report.

s0164.literal: The envoys of the Gold Teeth Kingdom were granted tally plaques.
s0164.idiomatic: The envoys of the Gold Teeth Kingdom were granted tally plaques.

s0165.literal: On guisi day offices of the secretariat, privy council, censorate, and ministries were fixed by selection; an edict informed court and realm: "Central Secretariat: aside from the secretariat director, one each of left and right grand councillor, two grand councillors, one each of left and right vice censor, two associate administrators;
s0165.idiomatic: On guisi day offices of the secretariat, privy council, censorate, and ministries were fixed by selection; an edict informed court and realm, "Central Secretariat: aside from the secretariat director, one each of left and right grand councillor, two grand councillors, one each of left and right vice censor, two associate administrators;

s0166.literal: Branch secretariat: two grand councillors, one each of left and right vice censor, two associate administrators and two branch-secretariat commissioners;
s0166.idiomatic: Branch secretariat: two grand councillors, one each of left and right vice censor, two associate administrators and two branch-secretariat commissioners;

s0167.literal: Privy Council: aside from the privy council director, one vice director, two deputy directors and two privy council commissioners, one privy council assessor;
s0167.idiomatic: Privy Council: aside from the privy council director, one vice director, two deputy directors and two privy council commissioners, one privy council assessor;

s0168.literal: Censorate: one censor-in-chief, two vice censors, two attendant censors, and two investigating censors;
s0168.idiomatic: Censorate: one censor-in-chief, two vice censors, two attendant censors, and two investigating censors;

s0170.literal: Six ministries: two each of ministers, vice ministers, bureau directors, and bureau vice directors.
s0170.idiomatic: Six ministries: two each of ministers, vice ministers, bureau directors, and bureau vice directors.

s0171.literal: All other offices are entrusted to the Central Secretariat to consider and cut as appropriate."
s0171.idiomatic: All other offices are entrusted to the Central Secretariat to consider and cut as appropriate."

s0172.literal: In the eighth month, on bingshen day, twenty-nine thousand ingots of paper currency and fifty thousand salt quotas were issued to purchase rice and relieve famine among the people under Prince Ajiji.
s0172.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingshen day, 29,000 ingots of paper currency and 50,000 salt quotas were issued to purchase rice and relieve famine among the people under Prince Ajiji.

s0173.literal: On jihai day the privy council was ordered to dispatch one thousand guard troops to escort the northern campaign.
s0173.idiomatic: On jihai day the privy council was ordered to dispatch 1,000 guard troops to escort the northern campaign.

s0174.literal: Pingyang Circuit had suffered poor harvests in successive years; taxes and levies of the poor were remitted.
s0174.idiomatic: Pingyang Circuit had suffered poor harvests in successive years; taxes and levies of the poor were remitted.

s0175.literal: Huaidong and Qihuang pacification commissions were abolished; Huang, Qi, and Shouchang were placed under Huguang Branch Secretariat; Anqing, Lu'an, and Guangzhou under Huaixi pacification commission.
s0175.idiomatic: Huaidong and Qihuang pacification commissions were abolished; Huang, Qi, and Shouchang were placed under Huguang branch secretariat; Anqing, Lu'an, and Guangzhou under Huaixi pacification commission.

s0176.literal: Former Song salt troops were recruited.
s0176.idiomatic: Former Song salt troops were recruited.

s0177.literal: The maritime trade supervisorate was placed under the Quanzhou maritime trade bureau.
s0177.idiomatic: The maritime trade supervisorate was placed under the Quanzhou maritime trade bureau.

s0178.literal: On yimao day Venus transgressed the Right Horn of the Chariot.
s0178.idiomatic: On yimao day Venus transgressed the Right Horn of the Chariot.

s0179.literal: On xinyou day Chen Xun and four others of Yongkang County, Wuzhou, plotted rebellion and were executed.
s0179.idiomatic: On xinyou day Chen Xun and four others of Yongkang County, Wuzhou, plotted rebellion and were executed.

s0180.literal: Gansu suffered famine; wine was prohibited.
s0180.idiomatic: Gansu suffered famine; wine was prohibited.

s0181.literal: Deping and Dingchang circuits were abolished and a Dechang military-civilian supervisorate was established.
s0181.idiomatic: Deping and Dingchang circuits were abolished and a Dechang military-civilian supervisorate was established.

s0182.literal: In the ninth month, on the yichou new moon, the ten states Ma'bar, Xumenna, Sangkelei, Nanwuli, Maland, Nawang, Dhufar, Lailai, Jilanyidai, and Samudra each dispatched sons to present memorials and pay court visits, also presenting local products as tribute.
s0182.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the yichou new moon, the ten states Ma'bar, Xumenna, Sangkelei, Nanwuli, Maland, Nawang, Dhufar, Lailai, Jilanyidai, and Samudra each dispatched sons to present memorials and pay court visits, also presenting local products as tribute.

s0183.literal: Because rain damaged the imperial ancestral temple, Wengjiladai was dispatched to report it, and the spirit tablets were moved to a side hall.
s0183.idiomatic: Because rain damaged the imperial ancestral temple, Wengjiladai was dispatched to report it, and the spirit tablets were moved to a side hall.

s0184.literal: On jiashen day the moon transgressed Tianguan.
s0184.idiomatic: On jiashen day the moon transgressed Tianguan.

s0185.literal: On xinchen day Goryeo dispatched envoys presenting Japanese captives.
s0185.idiomatic: On xinchen day Goryeo dispatched envoys presenting Japanese captives.

s0186.literal: That month in Nanbu County, one stalk of auspicious grain bore nine ears.
s0186.idiomatic: That month in Nanbu County, one stalk of auspicious grain bore nine ears.

s0188.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the jiawu new moon, Venus transgressed the Right Enforcer.
s0188.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on the jiawu new moon, Venus transgressed the Right Enforcer.

s0189.literal: Nankang Circuit was placed under Jiangxi Branch Secretariat, and the Zhexi surveillance commission was moved to govern from Hangzhou.
s0189.idiomatic: Nankang Circuit was placed under Jiangxi branch secretariat, and the Zhexi surveillance commission was moved to govern from Hangzhou.

s0190.literal: Assistant officials of the criminal-transport surveillance commissions in all circuits were abolished; traveling censorate investigating censors and surveillance commission officials, though Han, are likewise not forbidden bow and arrow.
s0190.idiomatic: Assistant officials of the criminal-transport surveillance commissions in all circuits were abolished; traveling censorate investigating censors and surveillance commission officials, though Han, are likewise not forbidden bow and arrow.

s0191.literal: Xiangyi county magistrate Zhang Qi had merit in governance; Zouping county darughachi Huihui was able to catch bandits and manage finances; promotions with differential ranks.
s0191.idiomatic: Xiangyi county magistrate Zhang Qi had merit in governance; Zouping county darughachi Huihui was able to catch bandits and manage finances; promotions with differential ranks.

s0192.literal: On dingyou day sacrifice was performed at the imperial ancestral temple.
s0192.idiomatic: On dingyou day sacrifice was performed at the imperial ancestral temple.

s0193.literal: On wuxu day the moon transgressed Establishment.
s0193.idiomatic: On wuxu day the moon transgressed Establishment.

s0194.literal: On jihai day the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.
s0194.idiomatic: On jihai day the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.

s0195.literal: On renyin day Venus transgressed the Left Enforcer.
s0195.idiomatic: On renyin day Venus transgressed the Left Enforcer.

s0196.literal: One thousand troops were dispatched to garrison the Uyghur frontier.
s0196.idiomatic: 1,000 troops were dispatched to garrison the Uyghur frontier.

s0197.literal: On yisi day cattle seed was granted to the impoverished of Hemili and the people of Helahe Prefecture, and sixteen thousand two hundred ingots of paper currency were issued as their price; the people of Hemili were additionally granted one thousand bolts of silk and cloth.
s0197.idiomatic: On yisi day cattle seed was granted to the impoverished of Hemili and the people of Helahe Prefecture, and 16,200 ingots of paper currency were issued as their price; the people of Hemili were additionally granted 1,000 bolts of silk and cloth.

s0198.literal: On jiyou day Tatardai and Yang Uludai were dispatched with ten thousand troops and one thousand ships to campaign against Guwei.
s0198.idiomatic: On jiyou day Tatardai and Yang Uludai were dispatched with 10,000 troops and 1,000 ships to campaign against Guwei.

s0199.literal: The Central Secretariat presented the establishment and reduction numbers for the Imperial Household Directorate, Grand Secretariat for Agriculture, Dadu, and Shangdu capital intendancies; the Emperor said: "For those near at court I shall cull myself; the rest I leave to your deliberation.
s0199.idiomatic: The Central Secretariat presented the establishment and reduction numbers for the imperial household directorate, grand secretariat for agriculture, Dadu, and Shangdu capital intendancies; the Emperor said, "For those near at court I shall cull myself; the rest I leave to your deliberation.

s0200.literal: " On xinhai day the moon transgressed the Eastern Well.
s0200.idiomatic: " On xinhai day the moon transgressed the Eastern Well.
